_comment: Hierarchical sample (examples/conveyor_machine.json): 装置(machine1) > 工程(process_feed, process_transport) > 動作(startstop_action, timer_action) > leaf blocks. `set`/`expect` use the FLATTENED node paths that the runtime actually executes (e.g. 'machine1/process_feed/y_feed'), exactly as they'd appear from GET /api/debug/state. This exercises the loader's group-flattening + boundary-port passthrough end to end, including 3-level nesting and fan-out (the feed latch's Q drives the feed motor, the transport process's run-in, AND the machine-level 'running' output simultaneously). Same SR set-dominant quirk as start_stop_basic.json applies to the innermost startstop_action group.
